scope: First 14 user-selected account screening for a broader channeling/mediumship discovery queue. This is separate from the frozen Bashar–Ra fitted corpus. Inclusion does not imply that all uploads are channeling, that a current inventory has been crawled, or that entity claims are factual.
method: Read bounded accessible publisher pages, explicitly marked secondary sources and retained repository identity evidence. No YouTube page requests, alternate YouTube proxies, login, membership access or audio downloads were performed for this screening. Irrelevant search results, generic directory fallbacks and a domain-for-sale page were discarded. No search-engine AI summary was evidence.

evidence.label: Exact-handle channel result indexed by Bing
evidence.note: Organic result at the exact channel URL describes a live stand-up comedy event recorded by The Habitat Team, Mumbai. Only the indexed source snippet was inspected; subscriber counts and unrelated search results were not used.

evidence.label: Same-name Linktree
evidence.note: Profile title is @viveksamtani, with an appearance/form link. This is insufficient evidence to verify the YouTube identity or classify the person as a medium or comedian.

channels.identity_evidence: Exact @VivekSamtani URL in a fresh organic search result; the earlier same-name profile alone was insufficient. Current channel contents were not fetched.
